Hon'ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Inder Pal Kohli, learned counsel for
the Appellant.
2. Present special leave to appeal is filed by
the appellant against the judgment and order
dated 27.03.2021 passed by learned ACJM/10th
Addl. Civil Judge (S.D.), Dehradun in
Complaint Case No.4351 of 2016.
3. Heard on delay condonation application.
4. The main objection raised by learned
counsel for the respondent is that despite having
sufficient knowledge there is deliberate delay on
part of the applicant as he was well aware of the
procedure.
5. Whereas the cause of delay as shown by
the appellant in the application and through oral
submission is that the applicant was in the
procedure as advised by the learned counsel,
who was filing the same and this is the cause for
delay.
6. After hearing the learned counsel for the
parties, the delay of 111 days in filing this
criminal appeal is well explained. Delay is
condoned. Accordingly, delay condonation
application is allowed.
7. Leave to appeal is granted.
8. Admit.
9. Let the objection be filed by the State
within two weeks.

10. Registry is directed to prepare the paper
book and supplied it to the concerned parties, as
per Rules.
11. List on 08.06.2026.
 (Ashish Naithani, J.)
